evidence_items.explanation: DeepFleet is material evidence against an assertion that generative AI has no robotics use. The announcement mixes prospective and realized language and describes an efficiency gain, without establishing the broader transformation threshold.

The technical work challenges the architectural rationale: models can be designed for robot coordination rather than text output alone. The abstract evaluates model designs and prediction tasks, which does not establish an operational transformation.
